context.transcript:
Thank you to the Clayton Museum for inviting me to give this
presentation about my most recent publication. My book
focuses on the history of the pottery makers who used to
thrive here in Clayton. In 1850 only one pottery company
made clay bowls and containers. By the next century, over
50 factories were making tableware, such as plates and
teacups. Tea sets were very popular at that time. As you
can see, there are several antique tea sets on the table here
next to the podium. You are welcome to come and take a
closer look after I'm finished speaking.
context.transcript_translation: 感谢克莱顿博物馆邀请我来介绍我最新出版的著作。我的书主要讲述过去曾在克莱顿蓬勃发展的陶器制造者的历史。1850 年时，只有一家公司生产陶碗和陶制容器。到了下一个世纪，已有五十多家工厂生产盘子、茶杯等餐具。当时，茶具非常受欢迎。大家可以看到，讲台旁边的桌子上摆着几套古董茶具。我的演讲结束后，欢迎各位走近仔细观赏。
